artifact_name: v2.1 External Candidate Acquisition Harness Plan
purpose: Design systematic external/fork candidate mining and preflight before any memory-vs-no-memory scoring attempt.

v2_0_blocked_acquisition_result_preserve.interpretation: v2.0 blocked at candidate acquisition. This is not negative capability evidence.

examples: small public benchmark repos with known failing tests
candidate_source_tiers.rationale: Curated bug benchmarks are more likely to provide clean checkout, deterministic failure, and repair oracle structure.

examples: small npm test repos with lockfiles
candidate_source_tiers.rationale: Small public repos with simple local commands may be preflighted cheaply for replay suitability.

examples: old package versions with reproducible dependency drift
repos with local install/test commands and no private service requirements
candidate_source_tiers.rationale: Archived repos can expose reproducible dependency or config drift if their environment is bounded and local.

examples: bug-labeled public issues with reproduction commands
small PRs with failing tests and local reproduction steps
closed issue branches that can be checked out locally
candidate_source_tiers.rationale: Issue replay can be useful, but requires careful filtering to avoid remote-only, subjective, or service-dependent evidence.
User-owned fallback can validate harness behavior but must not count as external/fork memory-lift evidence.

candidate_preflight_checks: deterministic failure presence or reproducible issue branch
preferred_ecosystems: JavaScript/TypeScript with npm test and lockfile
small Java/Maven/Gradle only if runtime is bounded
deprioritized_ecosystems: Flutter/Android unless environment is already stable
repos requiring private APIs or paid services

criteria.description: A local test/build/lint/check command exists and can be run from clean checkout.
The failure can be reproduced deterministically without remote-only CI or subjective judgment.
Dependencies are bounded, installable, and do not require private services or fragile global tooling.
License and ethics are clear enough for local fork/clone replay.
Setup plus replay can run within a bounded pilot budget.
No-memory and memory-enabled paths can run under identical replay conditions.
The task has plausible recurrence, coupling, stale-rule, downstream-risk, or transfer-trap relevance.
A downstream or no-sprawl corruption check can be defined before scoring.
Logs, diffs, manifests, snapshots, and proof ledgers can be captured and hashed.

v2_2_handoff_criteria: no-memory and memory-enabled paths are feasible

v2_2_expected_next_stage.purpose: Run the acquisition harness and produce a ranked replay-ready candidate pool before scoring.
